title: RENDER PULSE
description: RENDER PULSE — the fixed heartbeat of the frame. The presentation renders on a fixed grid: 16.6ms at the default 60, raisable on the ladder 120/240/360/480 via pulseHz. The beat is sacred — frame skipping was demoted to INSIDE the pulse window and can never skip the head render; QueOps receives exactly the time remaining to the next beat as its ceiling, so work that doesn't fit is delayed rather than allowed to push the beat. The verdict: every frame is bracketed into phases (physics, queops, data, render, debug, other), and any frame that overruns its window gets its heaviest phase BLAMED, counted and named in the ledger — that is how you declare what the problem is in between 16.6 and stabilize 60. Above the display's real Hz the extra beats cannot paint extra frames; they tighten the deadline and sharpen the blame window instead (4.17ms at 240). Time authority: excluded from benchmark rotation and the live Automatic.
